name: KiCad Blocks
description: Manage reusable, library-backed schematic functional blocks.

actions.name: Manage KiCad Functional Blocks
actions.description: Browse all registered functional-block libraries, preview blocks, and place facades.

actions.name: Create Block from Selected Sheet
actions.description: Create and place a reusable block from the selected hierarchical sheet.

actions.name: Open Block Implementation
actions.description: Open the selected block's implementation for its KB_VARIANT value.

actions.name: Configure Block Instance
actions.description: Configure the selected block instance's profile, variant, parameters, and PCB layout.

actions.name: Make Block Instance Local
actions.description: Create an independent project-local implementation for the selected block instance.

actions.name: Synchronize Local Block Copy
actions.description: Synchronize the selected project-local block copy with its shared library source.

actions.name: Edit Block Facade Symbol
actions.description: Open the selected block facade in KiCad Symbol Editor.

actions.name: Publish Block to Library
actions.description: Publish implementation and facade changes to the shared block library.

actions.name: Export Recursive Block BOM
actions.description: Export a recursive bill of materials for the selected block and dependencies.

actions.name: Run Recursive Block ERC
actions.description: Run electrical-rule checks for the selected block and nested dependencies.

actions.name: Validate Block Libraries
actions.description: Validate every registered block library, including manifests, assets, dependencies, and ERC.

actions.name: Apply Selected Block PCB Layout
actions.description: Merge the selected block's stored PCB layout into a separate project-board copy.

actions.name: Apply Multiple Block PCB Layouts
actions.description: Merge stored PCB layouts for multiple selected block instances into a separate board copy.

actions.name: Nest Block in Another Block
actions.description: Compose one registered functional block into another block implementation.

actions.name: Place Imported Block Layout
actions.description: Move a previously imported KiCad Blocks PCB layout using the native cursor placement tool.
